target.title: fix(memory): qmd search fails when logs prefix results
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where qmd-backed memory search could report invalid JSON when qmd writes bracketed log lines such as `[INFO]` before the actual result array.

## Why This Change Was Made

The noisy stdout parser now scans complete bracketed arrays until it finds one that normalizes as qmd results, while preserving the existing strict JSON and no-results behavior. The change stays inside the memory-host qmd parser and adds focused regression coverage for the bracketed log-prefix case.

## User Impact

Memory search can tolerate common qmd wrapper log prefixes and still return matching results instead of failing the lookup.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: bracketed qmd log prefixes before an embedded result array are skipped, and the parser returns the result array.
- Current-head proof at `4d971e42986f7a18311dd284a127c76fd16d00b8`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/qmd-query-parser.test.ts` passed.
- Runtime proof at `4d971e42986f7a18311dd284a127c76fd16d00b8`: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` returned `[{"docid":"abc","score":0.5}]` for a `[INFO] qmd ready` prefix before the result array.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Duplicate search: no matching open issues/PRs or closed PRs for `qmd query JSON noisy stdout` / `qmd-query-parser extractFirstJsonArray`.
